Story.metaDescription: The story of Lou Pitakass: from the Occitan Alps to the stage, between folk, live shows and records.
Story.title: Our story
Story.lead: From the valleys to the squares: the through-line of an Occitan folk band.
Story.galleryLead: Rehearsals, gigs and moments on the road.
Story.originsBody: Lou Pitakass grew from a wish to bring valley music to the stage: languages, dances and stories of the Occitan Alps. A lineup shaped by rehearsals, gatherings and encounters.
Story.soundTitle: Living folk, not a museum piece
Story.soundBody: Hurdy-gurdy, accordion, flute, guitar, bass and drums: traditional instruments with a contemporary pulse. The repertoire mixes tradition and original writing.
Story.roadBody: Gigs in Italy and beyond, folk festivals and dance nights. Each date is another pin on the map: new places, dancing crowds, and a band sharpening itself on stage.
Story.recordBody: Recording fixes a moment of the journey. The albums carry the band’s sound to anyone listening at home — or discovering Lou Pitakass for the first time.
Story.todayBody: We keep playing, writing and meeting people who love this music. The story isn’t closed: it’s the next rehearsal, the next date, the next night of celebration.

Privacy.metaDescription: Lou Pitakass privacy notice: how contact form data is processed.
Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.intro: This notice explains how {name} processes personal data submitted through the contact form on {domain}.
Privacy.dataBody: Through the form we collect name, email address and message content. No other personal data is required.
Privacy.purposeBody: Data is used only to read and reply to your request (booking, collaborations, information). The legal basis is consent given by checking the box before sending.
Privacy.recipientsBody: The message is delivered by email to the controller. Sending goes through Resend, a processor acting on our behalf. We do not sell or share data with third parties for marketing.
Privacy.retentionBody: We keep messages for as long as needed to handle the request and, if useful, a minimal correspondence history. Then we delete or anonymise them.
Privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction or objection, and withdraw consent. Email {email} and we will respond without undue delay.
Privacy.cookiesBody: The public site does not use profiling or tracking analytics cookies.
